fieldValues.comment_text: Settled by precedent (owner, 2026-10-27, vignette 431e12d6). This is the vignette rule (decision 77e04b19: words first as a source, records derived from them as suggestions) and the affirmation layer (a person affirms; no pipeline does) applied to a transcript instead of a chat. Option C is what those two already require; A loses the material and B skips the human act. Added to the SemanticOps decision log for ratification at the next session; it may be acted on meanwhile.
